Effects: piscovenom
The piscodaemon makes two claw Strikes against the same creature. If both hit, the creature takes 2d10 persistent bleed damage and is exposed to piscovenom.

(divine, misfortune, necromancy, poison)

Trigger: A creature within 30 feet attempts a saving throw against piscovenom

The creature takes an additional 2d8 poison damage even if it succeeds at its save.

description.value:
Your eyes glow as you sense aligned auras. Choose chaotic, evil, good, or lawful. You detect auras of that alignment. You receive no information beyond presence or absence. You can choose not to detect creatures or effects you're aware have that alignment.

Only creatures of 6th level or higher-unless divine spellcasters, undead, or beings from the Outer Sphere-have alignment auras.

higher_level_description.value: Heightened (2th): You learn each aura's location and strength.

description.value: You detect whether a creature is venomous or poisonous, or if an object is poison or has been poisoned. You do not ascertain whether the target is poisonous in multiple ways, nor do you learn the type or types of poison. Certain substances, like lead and alcohol, are poisons and so mask other poisons.

higher_level_description.value: Heightened (2th): You learn the number and types of poison.

description.value: You can see invisible creatures and objects. They appear to you as translucent shapes, and they are concealed to you.

higher_level_description.value: Heightened (5th): The spell has a duration of 8 hours.

description.value: Opening a door that bypasses normal space, you instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to a clear space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you-even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container-the spell is lost.

higher_level_description.value: Heightened (5th): The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are temporarily immune for 1 hour.

description.value:
You create a cloud of putrid mist in the area. The cloud functions as obscuring mist except it sickens creatures that end their turns within the cloud. (The concealed condition is not a poison effect.)

Critical Success: The creature is unaffected.
Success: The creature is sickened 1.
Failure: The creature is sickened 1 and slowed 1 while in the cloud.
Critical Failure: The creature is sickened 2 and slowed 1 until it leaves the cloud.
